summary: Mostly no. Most Moving Average Ratio settings did no better than random candles on BTC, ETH and SOL, and the shallow dip to 0.99 of EMA 20 showed nothing on 1h or 4h. The result that holds up is on 1h: after price crossed down through 0.97 of its EMA 20, it beat random entries by 0.46% after 20 candles, and uptrends carried it.

verdicts.use: Buying a deep dip (Price / EMA 20 crosses down 0.97)
verdicts.text: On 1h it beat random entries by 0.46% after 20 candles, on each of BTC, ETH and SOL, and at 10, 50 and 100 candles. On 4h it showed nothing, and on daily it did worse than random.

verdicts.use: Buying a shallow dip (Price / EMA 20 crosses down 0.99)
verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h or 4h. On daily it looked worse, but only because of one stretch between Mar 22, 2021 and May 12, 2021.

verdicts.use: Riding the trend (Price / EMA 50 above 1.01, rising 2% in 10 bars)
verdicts.text: On 1h it beat random entries by 0.35% and held at every horizon. On 4h and daily, the result rests on a single SOL stretch each time.

verdicts.use: Shorting a stretch above the average (Price / EMA 20 crosses up 1.03)
verdicts.text: On 1h it did 0.52% worse than random after 20 candles, and worse at every horizon. After price stretched above EMA 20, it kept rising.
On 1h it beat random by 0.16%, but only because of one entry on Feb 22, 2021. On 4h and daily it showed nothing.

notes: Price crossing down through 0.97 of its EMA 20 on 1h gave 2,136 entries in 978 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.46% ahead of random entries, above a luck band that topped out at 0.29%. It held on each pair, without its strongest stretch, and at 10, 50 and 100 candles. The shallower cross down through 0.99 fires about three times as often and showed nothing.

That dip result comes from uptrends. With the pair above its 200-day SMA, the 1h cross down through 0.97 beat random by 0.69%. Below it, the gap was 0.09%, inside the band. On 4h the same cross showed nothing, and on daily it did 4.11% worse than random after 20 days, at every horizon.

Price / EMA 50 above 1.01 and rising 2% in 10 bars beat random by 0.35% on 1h. It held at every horizon and without its strongest stretch. In uptrends the gap was 0.36%, while downtrends showed nothing. SOL carried it and BTC showed nothing. On 4h the result depends on SOL signals between Jul 22, 2021 and Sep 10, 2021, and is chance without them.

Shorting as price crossed up through 1.03 of EMA 20 on 1h did 0.52% worse than random after 20 candles, and at 10, 50 and 100 candles too. In uptrends it was 0.58% worse, and in downtrends it showed nothing. On 4h the worse result depends on one stretch between Aug 2, 2021 and Aug 15, 2021. On daily it was chance.

EMA 20 crossing up through EMA 50 on 1h beat random by 0.16%, but only because of one entry on Feb 22, 2021. Split by regime, 1h downtrends beat random by 0.29% and held without their strongest stretch, while uptrends showed nothing. On daily the pooled cross was chance, and neither regime had enough separate moves to judge.

On a 1h long DCA bot, the cross down through 0.97 of EMA 20 is a filter to test beside a trend condition, because uptrends carried it. Do not carry it to daily, where the same dip kept falling. A short bot that opens when price stretches to 1.03 above EMA 20 traded against continuation on 1h. Leave that setting out of short entries, or pair the EMA 50 trend setting with the bot's take profit on the long side.
